pr: PR2 (spec input; implementation under T-05 and reader-migration PRs)
title: vault_io.py spec (T-04) + reader-conversion checklist (T-07)
objective: Produce (a) the binding API + behaviour spec for etl4/vault/vault_io.py so developer-backend can implement under T-05, and (b) the authoritative list of pd.read_parquet / rglob / ParquetFile call sites that must migrate to vault_io.
unblocks: T-06 (unit-tester invariants rely on the spec's acceptance criteria)
T-08/T-09/T-10 (raw_vault.py rewrite - writer side uses vault_io.write_partition)
T-14 (marts.py rewrite - 9 reader sites + 4 writer sites per checklist)
T-17 (postgres_sink.py staged INSERT ON CONFLICT - 1 reader site)
T-22 (run_e2e pre-flight drift check - uses vault_io.list_ym)
T-24a (NEW - pipeline_volumes.py migration; surfaced as surprise call site)

acceptance_criteria.statement: vault_io_spec.md defines full signatures (not just type hints) for read_table, write_partition, row_count, list_ym, ym_from_filename, ym_from_date, ym_from_epoch, extract_ym_from_frame, extract_ym_from_path.
Reader fallback contract is specified for all four cases (monolith-only, partitioned-only, mixed, empty).
Partition layout reference quotes architecture.md §2.4 verbatim; ym truth table matches §2.5.
Non-goals section covers dedup, watermark table I/O, Postgres, bronze, GE suites, sort order.
reader_conversion_checklist.md lists every in-scope call site with file path, line numbers, current call, target call, and notes - grep-verified against feature/pipeline-3-avinash HEAD.
Checklist flags surprise call sites not in architecture.md section 5 (pipeline_volumes.py).

grep_evidence.command: rg -nE "read_parquet|rglob\(.\*\\.parquet.\)|ParquetFile\(" etl4/vault/marts.py etl4/vault/raw_vault.py etl4/vault/postgres_sink.py etl4/qa/reconcile.py etl4/qa/validate.py etl4/bench/run_matrix.py etl4/run_e2e.py etl4/orchestration/pipeline_volumes.py etl4/orchestration/ingest_runner.py
